songs.title: My Movie Review 🎬
lines: At the cinema, the lights go low,
What's the plot? What's the setting? Let's go!
Stunning special effects and CGI,
The climax is thrilling — oh my, oh my!
I absolutely loved it! I would recommend it!
A positive review — thumbs up, that's it!
I thought it was horrible, a mediocre plot.
I don't think you should see it — stop!
n: 곡조: Rap chant (4 beats) — 멜로디 없이 4박으로 읊는 챈트, 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
긍정 평에서는 엄지 위, 부정 평에서는 엄지 아래를 화면에 보여주기
songs.imgPrompt: Kids eating popcorn in a movie theater, some cheering and some frowning at the big screen.

songs.title: Wild or Tame? 🦁
lines: Lions live in nature, wild and free,
Deer run away from humans — see?
Dogs are raised by humans, tame and sweet,
Cats live with people on your street.
Animal cruelty? That goes too far!
It must be painful — it should be illegal.
Be responsible when you raise a pet,
Wild or tame — be kind, don't forget!
n: 곡조: Clap chant (4 beats) — 멜로디 없이 4박으로 읊는 챈트, 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
wild에서 사자 발톱, tame에서 강아지 쓰다듬기 흉내로 구분하기
songs.imgPrompt: A lion and deer in a forest on one side, children gently petting a dog and cat at home on the other.

songs.title: Uniforms? 👔
lines: Should we wear them? Should we wear them?
Uniforms? Uniforms?
They can help us focus, they can help us focus,
Fair trade, yes! Fair trade, yes!
I am unique, I am unique,
My own style! My own style!
I can't imagine it, I can't imagine it!
What's your view? What's your view?
n: 곡조: Frère Jacques (Are You Sleeping?) (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
찬성 줄에서는 고개 끄덕, 반대 줄에서는 고개 젓기로 support/oppose 표현하기
songs.imgPrompt: Students in neat school uniforms next to students in colorful casual clothes, happily debating.

songs.title: Vote for Me! 🗳️
lines: Vote for me, election day!
I'm honest and I'm ready,
I will listen to you all,
'Cause I'm a people person!
Candidates, come give a speech,
The campaign, the debate,
I'm the most qualified one,
So we should trust each other!
n: 곡조: Yankee Doodle (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
Vote for me에서 손을 번쩍 들고, I will listen에서 손을 귀에 대는 동작
songs.imgPrompt: Kids giving campaign speeches for class president with posters and a ballot box in a classroom.
